title: Justin Herbert back with Chargers, Jim Harbaugh happy about "good balance" in QB's life

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Justin Herbert back with Chargers, Jim Harbaugh happy about "good balance" in QB's life
sources.description: Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert's absence from the last couple of weeks of the team's offseason program came with a seal of approval from head coach Jim Harbaugh.
